title: Mobile Mechanic Customer Completion Sign-Off Form
subtitle: Control mobile diagnosis, vehicle stabilization, repair, testing, and return or tow decision through verified identity, domain-specific observations, evidence, authorization, exception ownership, and accountable closeout.
description: An original, workflow-complete mobile mechanic service customer completion sign-off for vehicles, systems, components, fluids, tools, supports, and work-zone controls. It connects approved repair scope, service information, and site plan to present conditions, repeatable evidence, decisions, unresolved work, and the receiving party's handoff.
use_case: Use when a qualified mobile mechanic and vehicle owner or authorized fleet contact must reconcile the promised mobile mechanic service scope, actual work, evidence, limitations, remaining actions, and custody transfer.

sections.title: Mobile Mechanic limitations, unresolved concerns, and callback plan
sections.guidance: Acceptance must not conceal a defect, incomplete task, service restriction, or promised follow-up.

blocks.label: Unresolved condition or follow-up trigger
items: Traffic, shoulder, grade, weather, lighting, or escape path is unsafe
Vehicle cannot be parked, braked, chocked, stabilized, or protected
Jack, stand, lift point, cribbing, or ground capacity is uncertain
Unexpected start, movement, pressure, heat, electrical, or high-voltage energy
Fuel, vapor, battery, fire, hot-surface, fluid, refrigerant, or spill concern
Tire, spring, air system, hydraulic system, or other stored energy uncontrolled
Service information, recall status, torque, calibration, or part compatibility uncertain
Repair exceeds mobile capability, available tools, environment, or authorization
Roadworthiness, braking, steering, tire, wheel, lighting, or structural condition uncertain
Customer requests driving or operation before required testing or tow decision

sections.title: Mobile Mechanic customer completion sign-off closeout and accountable handoff
sections.guidance: Close only when outcome, remaining limitation, next action, evidence, and receiving ownership agree.

blocks.label: Remaining action and follow-up register
Final outcome, handoff, and record location
Record boundary and stop condition
blocks.guidance: This mobile mechanic service customer completion sign-off is an operational record, not a substitute for applicable law, licensing, product labeling, manufacturer instructions, site policy, safety requirements, or professional judgment. Stop affected work, access, application, operation, testing, or release when traffic, vehicle support, lifting, stored energy, high voltage, fuel, fire, weather, spill, repair information, or roadworthiness condition is uncertain. A automotive or fleet safety supervisor must review the exception, authorize the controlling decision, and preserve its evidence before closeout.
